Activity: Approach Any Shrine to Mara or Mother Morrowind while Grouped with a Player or Companion
Description: Approach any Shrine to Mara or Mother Morrowind while grouped with a player or companion. These shrines are near Rededication Shrines in major cities such as Elden Root, Mournhold, and Wayrest.

Activity: Visit Elden Root Temple while Grouped with a Player or Companion
Description: Visit Elden Root Temple while grouped with a player or companion. Elden Root Temple is on a small island just north of Elden Root in Grahtwood.

Activity: Use the Celebration Emote at the Steps of the Tribunal Temple
Description: Visit the steps of the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold, Deshaan, and use the Celebration (/celebrate) emote, which you can find in the Entertainment category of the Emotes menu.

Activity: Use the Amulet of the Heart 2 Times
Description: Use the Amulet of the Heart memento at any location. The Amulet of the Heart is in the Tools section of the Collections menu after completing the Hearts Week quest, "Matters of the Heart".
